news.headline: Saints touchdown taken away by replay review
news.summary: Chase Young knocked the ball loose from Jared Goff in the second quarter and Jonas Sanker picked it up and ran it in. Officials looked at the replay and ruled it an incomplete pass instead, so the touchdown did not count.

news.headline: Saints lose in overtime after a 21-point comeback
news.summary: New Orleans was behind 21-0 and came all the way back to tie the game with 1:07 left. In overtime Tyler Shough threw an 8-yard touchdown pass to Noah Fant, but the two-point pass that would have won it fell incomplete and Detroit won 31-30.

news.headline: Chris Olave has the best game of his career
news.summary: Olave caught 10 passes for 182 yards at Detroit, more yards than he has ever had in a game. Tyler Shough threw for 410 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in his first game of the season.

news.headline: Sumrall is not satisfied after the big win
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said he still feels uneasy about his team even after a 52-3 win. Florida starts its conference schedule next Saturday at Auburn.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III returns two punts for touchdowns
news.summary: Brown ran back two punts in a row for scores in Saturday's 52-3 win over Campbell. He is the first Florida player to return two punts for touchdowns in the same game since 1996.

news.headline: Florida rolls past Campbell 52-3
news.summary: Vernell Brown III ran two punts back for touchdowns, something no Florida player had done in one game since 1996. Jadan Baugh ran for 136 yards and two more scores, and the Gators are 2-0.

news.headline: LSU moves up to No. 7 in the new poll
news.summary: LSU is 2-0 and climbed to seventh in Sunday's Associated Press poll after beating Louisiana Tech 45-14. Next Saturday the Tigers play at No. 8 Ole Miss.

news.headline: LSU beats Louisiana Tech 45-14
news.summary: Sam Leavitt ran for three touchdowns and threw for 344 yards, but he also threw three interceptions. The LSU defense held Louisiana Tech to 140 yards and sacked its quarterback seven times.

news.headline: SEC meets but takes no vote on LSU
news.summary: The league's school presidents met by video call Thursday and did not vote on LSU's membership. The SEC said afterward only that the talks will keep going.

news.headline: Jaylin Lucas runs for 214 yards
news.summary: Lucas carried the ball 11 times for 214 yards and a touchdown in Saturday's 28-24 win over South Alabama. That is close to 20 yards every time he ran it.

news.headline: Tulane wins its home opener 28-24
news.summary: Jaylin Lucas ran for 214 yards, including an 80-yard touchdown. Kadin Semonza threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Destyn Hill with 1:17 left to put Tulane ahead for good.

news.headline: Tulane wears Mardi Gras uniforms Saturday night
news.summary: Tulane plays South Alabama at home Saturday night in green, purple and gold uniforms made for Mardi Gras. The helmet shows the Angry Wave in a jester hat with beads around it, and the back of the helmet reads "Uptown."
